title: An orthonormal family can miss half the space
promptMarkdown: In $\ell^2(\mathbb N)$ retain only $e_2,e_4,e_6,\ldots$. Describe their closed span and orthogonal complement. Compute the limit of the associated projections of an arbitrary $x$. Give a nonzero vector for which all the retained coefficients vanish and explain why Parseval fails for this family.
hintLadder: Test orthogonality against each retained coordinate vector.
Use truncation and the square-summable tail to identify the closed span.
